items.t: Engine burns oil and can wear out the timing chain
items.note: GM special coverage has expired. Timing chain parts add to the job if they are worn.

items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners

items.t: Windshield wipers can quit when a linkage joint fails
items.note: Free under recall 16V582 (2013) or 22V165 (2014-2015). Other years were under a GM special coverage.

items.t: Low-beam headlights throw too much glare
items.note: Free under recall 22V137. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Right front axle shaft can break
items.job: Replace right front intermediate drive shaft
items.note: Free under recall 17V516. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Airbag control module can stay switched off
items.job: Reprogram or replace airbag sensing module
items.note: Free under recall 18V340. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Transmission stop-start accumulator can be missing bolts
items.job: Inspect and replace stop-start accumulator end cap bolts
items.note: Free under recall 20V668. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake vacuum pump can fail and make the pedal hard

items.note: Free under recall 23V869. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Coolant can seep from the water pump
items.note: Should be covered by the factory powertrain warranty on a 2026 model.
